description: This file implements the NativeJSPlugin class, which manages the initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval for a NativeJS plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes registration, singleton management, and interaction with external interfaces such as INativeJS.

classes.name: NativeJS
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and registration of the NativeJS plugin within the WPEFramework, including singleton management and interaction with native interfaces.

methods.name: NativeJS::NativeJS
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the singleton instance and base classes.

methods.name: NativeJS::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin, sets up native interface, and registers the plugin.

methods.name: NativeJS::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, unregisters, releases resources, and resets singleton.

methods.name: NativeJS::Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with the service name.
